messages:
alex_cs: heads up — MedAssist (customer-id medassist-42) just escalated. They say their triage chat started refusing benign medical guidance that used to be allowed after yesterday's safety policy rollout. customer transcript pasted below. can we triage?

alex_cs: customer example (user -> triage-bot):
USER: I have a fever and sore throat for 2 days, what should I do?
BOT: Sorry, I can’t help with that. You should contact a healthcare professional.

alex_cs: previously the bot returned a short self-care checklist and recommended escalation only when specific red flags were present. this is blocking production flows. API request id: req_0a7b2c9f.

m_chen: thanks — can you confirm model + variant + rollout timing? also did they use Hosted or Dedicated?

alex_cs: Hosted, model: rw-infer-large-2026-11 (we had a canary of safety-policy v3 + model config tweak rolled to 25% at 2026-11-04T22:10Z). customer traffic hit the canary cluster for ~18% of their requests.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout: safety-policy-v3 -> 25% traffic at 2026-11-04T22:10:13Z. Started by sara_prod.

javi_oncall: can you paste the exact API payload they sent (redacted keys)? need prompt + system message.

alex_cs: pasted sample request (redacted):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model": "rw-infer-large-2026-11",
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a medical triage assistant. Provide safe guidance and escalate when necessary."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "I have a fever and sore throat for 2 days, what should I do?"}
  ],
  "customer_id": "medassist-42",
  "request_id": "req_0a7b2c9f"
}
```

m_chen: rough hypothesis: safety-policy-v3 tightened refusal heuristics for content containing medical terms, but we tuned it for open-chat moderation. Triages are more nuanced — the policy may be mapping 'fever' -> high-risk token and triggering binary refusal. Could be a ruleset mismatch or an unintended overlap with new regexes.

tina_sre: throwing telemetry queries now. pulling annotation logs for req_0a7b2c9f and similar. give me ~5m.

ops-bot: logs attached: routed to canary cluster instance canary-17, safety-eval score 0.92, matched rule: med-term-flag + generic-refusal.

javi_oncall: is 0.92 the aggregated safety score or a per-rule weight?

m_chen: aggregated. per-rule: med-term-flag=0.7, generic-refusal=0.2, profanity=0.0. The med-term-flag is new in v3 (regex for medical keywords + intent heuristics).

alex_cs: customer reports similar exchange where the bot returned a one-line refusal for basic triage questions across ~12 unique prompts. They rolled this update to prod for some customers; MedAssist got partial traffic.

sara_prod: fwiw I approved v3 canary because internal evals reduced hallucinated medical instructions. looks like we overgeneralized. we should decide rollback vs patch.

m_chen: immediate mitigation options: 1) roll back safety-policy-v3 for MedAssist (feature-flag per-customer) 2) create an allowlist override for triage workflows that routes through v2 policy 3) patch v3 regexes to be more context-aware (longer-term). I recommend option 1+3: rollback for customer to restore UX, then patch and test.

alex_cs: customer asks for ETA. they want fix within 4 hours ideally.

tina_sre: rollback steps: flip policy assignment for medassist-42 to safety-policy-v2 by toggling flag in control-plane (ui + infra api). I'll coordinate with infra.

deploy-bot: Note: partial rollback will not affect universal canary metrics. Action requires config change: PUT /config/customers/medassist-42 {"policy":"v2"}.

javi_oncall: also need to gather representative prompts to run eval harness and check for false negatives. alex, can you collect 6-10 failing prompts and paste?

alex_cs: adding examples:
- "I've been coughing and feverish for 36 hours, any advice?" -> refusal
- "My child has a rash and low-grade fever, should I see a doctor?" -> refusal
- "Headache and dizziness after minor fall, what to watch for?" -> refusal

m_chen: thanks. I'll run these through local safety-sim with v2 vs v3 and share diff. initial guess: med-term-flag uses short token window and lacks system-intent weighting, so it triggers for short prompts.

tina_sre: rolled flag for medassist-42 to v2 at 2026-11-05T01:22:38Z. change id cfg_9c3e.

ops-bot: Config change applied. Affected hosts: canary-17, canary-19.

alex_cs: customer confirms improvement on quick check: responses are back to expected style. they still want root cause and assurance before we re-roll v3.

m_chen: root cause analysis plan: 1) reproduce locally with same model binary + quantization profile; 2) run safety-rules unit tests focusing on med-term-flag; 3) audit rule definitions (regexes and intent model) to add context windows and system-weighting; 4) run expanded evals on triage prompt set. I can take 1-3, aim to have a patch in ~48h.

sara_prod: please include product in change review; we need a safe path to reintroduce improvements (reduced hallucinations) without breaking triage workflows.

javi_oncall: I'll open a JIRA: CS-2129 "safety-v3 overrefusal for medical triage — MedAssist" and link logs + config change. owners: m_chen (eng-ml), tina_sre (eng-sre), sara_prod (product), alex_cs (CS).

alex_cs: customer asked for a postmortem and timeline. I'll tell them: rollback done, we're investigating, patch ETA 48h, will coordinate a staged re-roll with their QA.

m_chen: one more note — need to check if quantized kernel change in rw-infer-large-2026-11 altered tokenization boundary behavior. small tokenization differences can shift regex matches. I'll diff tokenizations for the sample prompts.

tina_sre: saved all artifacts under /vault/incidents/CS-2129 (logs, req ids, config snapshots).

alex_cs: thanks team. will keep customer updated. tagging follow-ups: @m_chen assign triage evals, @tina_sre keep rollback audit, @sara_prod coordinate product review. :thumbsup:

javi_oncall: reminder: when re-rolling, do a limited canary on customers classified as triage workflows and monitor refusal-rate delta + intent coverage. set alert if refusal-rate increases > 10% vs baseline.

sara_prod: agreed. will add canary gating and sample prompts by workflow.

alex_cs: closing loop — customer acknowledged and appreciated the quick response. will reopen if they see regressions after re-roll.

deploy-bot: Ticket CS-2129 created and linked to config change cfg_9c3e.

ops-bot: summary: cause suspected = safety-policy-v3 med-term-flag regex/intention; mitigation = per-customer rollback to v2; next = safety rule patch + targeted re-canary.
